thread.title: An Aggressive Play on OLED Into Earnings

title: An Aggressive Play on OLED Into Earnings
text:
An Aggressive Play on OLED Into Earnings By Timothy Collins | Aug 3, 2018 | 2:33 PM EDT
Apple (AAPL) , with its strong earnings report, has brought a few suppliers back to life this week, in my eyes. My favorite setup here is Universal Display (OLED) . The company is the brainchild and patent holder behind almost everything OLED (organic light-emitting diode), design and usage, not the supply components.
Universal Display is set to report earnings next week on Aug. 9, so this is a bit of a gamble here and needs to be defined....245
